s1.desc: a dining area with a round cream table and wooden chairs, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with paper trays of fried bites on lettuce on the table

beats.text: Pax gobbles the fried bites from his tray one after another while Polly picks up a single piece
Pax sits back chewing with crumbs around his beak and one flipper raised, his tray now empty
Pax stares over at Polly's tray with crumbs on his face while Polly sits with her flippers resting by her food
Polly lifts a fried bite from her tray up toward her beak while Pax watches

spans.view: with a paper tray of fried bites on the table in front of her

beats.text: Polly holds up a fried bite on a pick and pops it into her beak
Polly chews with her eyes closed and a happy smile, lowering her flipper to the tray

spans.view: with paper trays of fried bites on lettuce on the table

beats.text: Pax leans over toward Polly's tray, eyeing her food, while Polly chews with her eyes closed
Pax sits back upright and gazes off to the side while Polly keeps chewing with her eyes closed
Polly opens her eyes, lifts a fried bite and pops it into her beak while Pax watches
Pax sits with his flippers on the table, staring at Polly's food, while Polly looks back at him
Pax turns to face forward and folds his flippers on the table, glancing sideways at Polly
Polly picks up a white napkin and dabs her beak with it while Pax sits with folded flippers
Polly sits back with her eyes closed and a content smile while Pax watches her
Polly opens her eyes and pushes her tray across the table toward Pax as he unfolds his flippers
Pax grabs a fried bite from her tray and gobbles it with his eyes shut as a small heart floats up
